scripts.predev: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:pong
scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:pong && npm run check:game-boundaries && next build
scripts.pretest: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:pong
scripts.pregenerate:game-manifest: npm run build:sdk && npm --prefix games/chibasko-pong run build:server
scripts.precheck:game-manifest: npm run build:sdk && npm --prefix games/chibasko-pong run build:server
scripts.test: node --import ./tests/register.mjs --test tests/security.test.mjs tests/cloudflare.test.mjs tests/r2-thumbnails.test.mjs tests/r2-avatars.test.mjs tests/playground-connection.test.mjs tests/lobby-connection.test.mjs tests/lobby-game-session.test.mjs tests/game-catalogue.test.mjs tests/product-session.test.mjs tests/game-sdk.test.mjs tests/pong-local.test.mjs && npm run test:product && npm run test:admin
scripts.preview:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && node scripts/cloudflare.mjs preview
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && node scripts/cloudflare.mjs deploy
scripts.test:pong-local: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:pong && node --import ./tests/register.mjs --test tests/pong-local.test.mjs && node --import ./tests/product-register.mjs --test tests/pong-local-product.test.mjs
scripts.test:pong: npm run build:sdk && npm --workspace @chibaskogames/chibasko-pong run typecheck && npm --workspace @chibaskogames/chibasko-pong test
scripts.pretest:product: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:pong
